name: taskline
description: Live progress of every long-running job above the Claude Code prompt: bars, speed, ETA, stall and crash detection. Jobs report via a one-file JSON protocol (Python helper and CLI included) or are watched from their files and logs.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: one line when everything fits, else one row per task · single: always one line · stacked: always one row per task

maxTasks.title: Max tasks
maxTasks.description: How many tasks to draw at most; the rest fold into "+N more"

stalledAfter.title: Stalled after (s)
stalledAfter.description: A running task with no update for this long is shown as stalled

doneVisible.title: Done visible (s)
doneVisible.description: How long a finished task stays (green) before it disappears

errorVisible.title: Error visible (s)
errorVisible.description: How long a failed or aborted task stays (red) unless you clear it

color.title: Color
color.description: Colored bars and states (NO_COLOR in the environment turns it off too)

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: Spinner and smooth ETA countdown at 4 fps; off = one redraw per second

celebrate.title: Celebrate
celebrate.description: When a bar fills, it bursts into sparks and a green check with CHECK!! plays above the band (about 3 s; one line instead on the desktop app or with animation off)

cleanup.title: Clean up
cleanup.description: Delete progress files of finished tasks once they are no longer shown

progressDir.title: Progress directory
progressDir.description: Where jobs write their progress files

watchersFile.title: Watchers file
watchersFile.description: JSON file with filesize / logtail / dircount watchers for jobs that report nothing
